fields.description: Expense ledger used to record shift cash discrepancies.
fields.label: Cash Over/Short Account

fields.description: Parent account group for ad-hoc expenses.
fields.label: Indirect Expenses Parent

fields.description: Expense account for freight / delivery charges.
fields.label: Freight Charges Account

fields.description: Receivable account tracking courier balances.
fields.label: Courier Outstanding Account

fields.description: Parent group for online-payment bank accounts.
fields.label: Bank Accounts Parent

fields.description: Account for Mobile Wallet payments.
fields.label: Mobile Wallet Account

fields.description: Override the company default receivable account.
fields.label: Default Receivable Account

fields.description: Override the company default payable (Creditors) account.
fields.label: Default Payable Account

fields.description: Fallback UOM when an item has no stock_uom.
fields.label: Default Stock UOM

fields.description: Price list for purchase operations.
fields.label: Buying Price List

fields.description: Employee Group that holds courier employees.
fields.label: Delivery Employee Group

fields.description: Supplier Group for courier suppliers.
fields.label: Delivery Supplier Group

fields.description: Hours an unpaid InstaPay/Mobile Wallet order can sit Out for Delivery awaiting payment before the hourly escalation job alerts managers.
fields.label: InstaPay Unconfirmed Alert Hours

fields.description: Text shown at top of printed receipts.
fields.label: Receipt Header

fields.description: Text shown at bottom of printed receipts.
fields.label: Receipt Footer

fields.description: Phone number displayed on receipts.
fields.label: Receipt Phone

fields.description: Website URL displayed on receipts.
fields.label: Receipt Website

fields.description: Logo image shown on receipts.
fields.label: Receipt Logo

fields.description: Base64url-encoded uncompressed EC public key served to browsers for pushManager.subscribe(). Auto-generated on first use.
fields.label: VAPID Public Key

fields.description: PEM-format EC private key used to sign VAPID push requests. Auto-generated on first use. Never expose this value.
fields.label: VAPID Private Key

fields.description: URL or mailto: identifying the push sender to Apple/Google push servers.
fields.label: VAPID Subject

fields.description: Master switch for the post-dispatch return workflow. When off, the return endpoints refuse and the client hides the action. Turning it off is the instant rollback lever — it needs no deploy or restart.
fields.label: Enable Invoice Returns

fields.description: Master switch for the per-invoice courier transitions (Arrived / Delivered / Failed). When off, the service refuses and the courier app hides the actions. Read in the service, not the API, so every caller — HTTP, harness, background job — hits the same gate. Instant rollback lever: no deploy, no restart.
fields.label: Enable Courier Delivery Actions

fields.description: How many days back a manager may post a production batch. Beyond this only a System Manager may go, because that is the range that reaches a closed accounting period. Operators can never backdate at all.
fields.label: Production Max Backdate Days

fields.description: Largest material value (at valuation rate) one operator may commit in a single batch. 0 means no limit. Managers always bypass it.
fields.label: Operator Batch Value Limit

fields.description: Allow finishing a batch with more good output than the Work Order planned. Off by default: a quantity above plan is far more often a typo than a genuine over-yield.
fields.label: Allow Over-Production

fields.description: Sub-assembly whose default BOM defines one batch for the Daily Production Plan. Deliberately Data and not Link: a stale Link on this Single blocks every full save of it, and a mistyped name here degrades to the built-in default rather than locking the Settings form. Leave blank to use 'Cheesecake Mix'.
fields.label: Production Mix Item

fields.description: Batch sizes the mixer will accept in one run, comma separated. Leave blank for 1, 1.5, 2. The plan never schedules a run smaller than the smallest value here.
fields.label: Mixer Run Sizes

fields.description: Where purchased stock lands when nothing more specific applies. Resolution order per line: warehouse chosen on the line → the Item's own default warehouse for the company → the Item Group routes below → this warehouse. Set this to the raw-materials store, since that is what most purchases are.
fields.label: Default Purchase Warehouse

fields.description: Route purchases to a warehouse by Item Group — e.g. Raw Material → the raw-materials store, Consumable → the consumables store. The most specific matching group wins, so a child group overrides its parent.
fields.label: Purchase Warehouse Routes

fields.description: Purchase Taxes and Charges Template applied to new purchases by default (e.g. the 14% VAT template). Leave blank for no default; the buyer can always change it.
fields.label: Default Purchase Taxes Template

fields.description: Require the supplier's own invoice/bill number on every purchase. ERPNext already rejects a duplicate bill number for the same supplier, so turning this on makes that guard actually bite.
fields.label: Require Supplier Bill Number

fields.description: Default lead time in days for a team item request — used as the 'needed by' date when the requester does not pick one.
fields.label: Request Default Lead Days
